title: Beef with vegetables (carrots, broccoli, dark‑green leafy) no potatoes, mushroom sauce

content.title: About
content.content: Beef with vegetables is a dish that combines lean cuts of beef with carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy vegetables (such as spinach or kale). It is prepared without potatoes and without mushroom sauce, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is a rich source of iron, zinc and vitamin B12.
Broccoli provides high amounts of vitamin C, vitamin K and detox‑supporting phytochemicals.
Dark‑green leafy greens are packed with folate and carotenoids.
Carrots are one of the richest sources of beta‑carotene, a precursor of vitamin A.
Omitting potatoes and mushroom sauce reduces carbohydrate content and glutamate levels.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Beef protein aids muscle growth and recovery, especially for active individuals.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamin C from broccoli and beta‑carotene from carrots enhance the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Vitamin K and calcium in leafy greens contribute to bone mineralization.

items.title: Vision support
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots converts to vitamin A, essential for good eyesight.

items.title: Reduces inflammation
items.content: Antioxidants from beef, broccoli and greens help lower oxidative stress.

items.title: Saturated fat excess
items.content: Choosing lean cuts of beef is important; otherwise the dish may contain too much saturated fat.

items.title: Beef allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beef.

items.title: Digestive issues
items.content: High fiber from broccoli and greens can cause gas in sensitive people.

items.title: Portion control
items.content: The dish is protein‑ and calorie‑dense; moderation is key for weight management.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sear beef pieces until browned, add sliced carrots and broccoli, simmer until tender, then stir in leafy greens at the end. Season with salt, pepper and herbs as desired. Serve hot, optionally drizzled with lemon juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cooked dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. For freezing, portion into freezer bags and keep for up to 2 months. Reheat to an internal temperature of 75 °C.
